rule: A synthetic SQL value for a column the seed cannot derive from its type or its CHECK, keyed schema.table.column: a domain rule a trigger or a CHECK across columns enforces. Never a real value. scripts/ci/foundation_postgres_production_shape.py reads it. not_yet_seeded names, with why, each table production holds rows in that the seed cannot fill yet; it only shrinks: a named table that seeds is refused until removed.

not_yet_seeded.catalog.administrative_unit_parent: the parent hierarchy trigger needs a second administrative unit of the parent kind
not_yet_seeded.catalog.bronze_object_member: the measurement-holds-its-members trigger needs a zip measurement whose member_count equals its members
not_yet_seeded.catalog.parcel_publication_source_eviden: needs a succeeded parcel mirror rebuild run, which is inserted planned and moved by the publisher
not_yet_seeded.serving_postgis.spatial_projection_load: needs sealed parcel publication source evidence (see catalog.parcel_publication_source_evidence)
not_yet_seeded.catalog.vector_tile_release: a dynamic_postgis release needs a postgis projection revision from a projection load
